title: Value-Rich, Differently Organized: Measuring Value Expression and Organization in AI-Generated Debates
abstract: arXiv:2610.28604v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current evaluation of LLM-generated debate largely focuses on argumentative quality, leaving the value structure of generated arguments underexamined. We introduce a diagnostic metric framework for comparing how values are expressed and organized in human-reference and AI-generated debates. The framework separates value expression, the range of recognizable values a debate invokes, from value organization, how those values are distributed and sustained across turns. Grounded in Schwartz's Basic-10 value theory, it represents debates as multi-level value distributions over argumentative units, utterances, stances, and full debates, enabling metrics for value coverage, alignment, diffusion, and cross-turn dynamics. Across multiple generation systems, AI-generated debates are broadly value-expressive, often activating as many or more value dimensions than matched human references, but they organize these values differently. translated_title: 价值丰富但组织方式不同：测量AI生成辩论中的价值表达与组织
translated_abstract: 当前对大语言模型（LLM）生成辩论的评估主要聚焦于论辩质量，而对所生成论点的价值结构缺乏充分考察。我们提出了一个诊断性度量框架，用于比较人类参考辩论与AI生成辩论中价值的表达与组织方式。该框架将“价值表达”——即辩论所调用的可识别价值的范围——与“价值组织”——即这些价值如何在各轮次中分布和延续——区分开来。该框架以施瓦茨的基本十种价值理论为基础，将辩论表示为论辩单元、话语、立场和整场辩论等多个层级上的价值分布，从而支持价值覆盖、对齐、扩散以及跨轮次动态等度量指标。在多个生成系统中，AI生成的辩论普遍具有丰富的价值表达，往往能激活与相匹配的人类参考辩论相当甚至更多的价值维度，但它们对这些价值的组织方式有所不同。其话语……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于施瓦茨价值理论的诊断性度量框架，将辩论表示为多层级价值分布，发现AI生成的辩论在价值表达上与人类辩论一样丰富甚至更丰富，但对这些价值的组织和跨轮次延续方式与人类不同。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Schwartz-grounded diagnostic metric framework that represents debates as multi-level value distributions and finds that AI-generated debates are as value-expressive as—or more expressive than—matched human debates, yet they organize and sustain those values differently across turns.
